name: The Scotsman's Lounge
description: The Scotsman's Lounge has been trading as a pub on Cockburn Street since 1860, making it one of the older continuously running pubs on this stretch of the Old Town. Its traditional interior keeps a small stage area for live musicians, who perform most evenings, and it sells a large range of malt whiskies just a couple of minutes' walk from the Royal Mile.
interesting_fact: The pub's reopening after a refurbishment was significant enough locally that the City of Edinburgh Council's own leader issued a public welcome for it - a nod to how much these small independent Cockburn Street venues matter to the area's identity.
